short_description.value: RingMo-Agent is a unified remote sensing foundation model for multi-platform and multi-modal reasoning, supporting perception and reasoning tasks across optical, SAR, and infrared modalities from both satellite and UAV platforms. It leverages a large-scale vision-language dataset (RS-VL3M) with over 3 million image-text pairs and introduces modality-adaptive representations and a token-based high-dimensional hidden state decoding mechanism for long-horizon spatial tasks.

pretraining.value: Two-stage training: vision-language generation (generative training on paired RS image-text data) and instruction-tuning (aligning outputs with user instructions).

value.value: Separate embedding layers for optical, SAR, and infrared modalities

image_resolution.value: variable (min 92x92 to max 800x800, with patching to 384x384)

application.value: Trajectory planning for UAV navigation in urban environments
Step-by-step action planning for UAVs in urban scenes
